name: Hidden Storage
description: This suite comes equipped with hidden storage compartments, which have a capacity equal to half your ship's base cargo capacity, as shown in the **[Starship Size Cargo Capacity](#Starship%20Size%20Cargo%20Capacity)** table on page 79. Finding the hidden storage compartments requires a successful DC 20 Intelligence (Investigation) or Wisdom (Perception) check, which is made with disadvantage.
